chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel, from Harun ibn Kharjat, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, the worshippers are three types: A group worshipped Allah, Mighty and Majestic, out of fear, so that is the worship of the slaves; and a group worshipped Allah, Blessed and High, seeking the reward, so that is the worship of the employees; and a group worshipped Allah, Mighty and Majestic, out of love for Him, so that is the worship of the free ones, and it is the most superior of the worships.
ai.seo_question: What are the three levels of worship in Shia Islam and which is the best?
ai.summary: This foundational hadith from al-Kafi delineates the spiritual hierarchy of worship (ibadah) through the lens of motivation, a classification widely utilized in Shia tafsir and usul al-din to distinguish between transactional piety and existential devotion. By identifying love (hubb) as the domain of the 'free' (al-ahrar), it elevates worship from a duty of servitude to an act of voluntary intimacy with the Divine, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the inner state (batin) over mere outward form. This tripartite model serves as a practical framework for believers to self-assess their spiritual maturity and strive for the highest station of loving servitude.
